resources.string: Optional microphone sharing for call recording without root. Enable non-root recording inside Call Recorder as well. Phone state permission detects cellular calls. No screen content is read or stored. Android and your device may block remote audio; speakerphone may help. Recordings are stored locally.
Set up automatic recording in Settings, or start a recording below.

VoIP detection uses ongoing call notifications from selected apps and the active communication audio route. Apps may omit these notifications. Audio capture depends on your ROM and audio hardware. Automatic uses microphone for VoIP; privileged voice sources can be tried manually but do not guarantee remote audio. Playback capture cannot bypass call audio restrictions.

Enable this option and the accessibility service, then allow microphone and phone state permissions. It records microphone audio where Android permits it; speakerphone may help capture the other person. Two-sided audio is not guaranteed. No screen text is accessed. Background restrictions may require tapping the call notification to start.

Automatic tries privileged voice-call audio for cellular calls, otherwise voice-recognition microphone, then microphone. Manual sources are tried exactly as selected. Protected voice sources require CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT; merely having root is not sufficient. Settings apply to the next recording.
